subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrow WhatsApp suppression tradeoff after rebase, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary?
rationale: Both paths address spurious WhatsApp composing signals, but they make different user-visible tradeoffs and the broader path changes more runtime/API surface.

options.title: Accept Narrow Mitigation After Rebase
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, preserve the admitted conversation and groupMention path, and accept that rare proactive unmentioned visible replies may not show typing.

options.title: Prefer Visible-Delivery Boundary
options.body: Pause or close this branch only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 is refreshed, reviewed, and chosen as the canonical structural fix.

options.title: Keep Current Typing Semantics
options.body: Decline broad unmentioned-group suppression if maintainers prefer typing indicators for proactive automatic visible replies over eliminating this silent-run false positive.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Mitigation After Rebase
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, preserve the admitted conversation and groupMention path, and accept that rare proactive unmentioned visible replies may not show typing.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery PR and has recent merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch path.
